# Scale AI Appoints Francis deSouza as CEO to Lead Next Phase of Company’s Growth
By The Scale Team · July 30, 2026 · 3 min read
Copy Link
Scale AI Appoints Francis deSouza as CEO to Lead Next Phase of Company’s Growth
Scale AI today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Francis deSouza as Chief Executive Officer, effective August 10, 2026.
The appointment comes as Scale's momentum accelerates, with customer growth across both its data and applications businesses. Recent wins include the addition of enterprise customers such as BP and Mayo Clinic, along with expanded business with both U.S.
and international governments. Jason Droege, who has led the company as interim CEO since June 2025, will work closely with Francis over the coming months to help with the transition.

Posted Jul 30, 2026 at 2:52 PM UTC
H
Hayden Field
Scale AI has a new CEO: the current COO of Google Cloud.
Francis deSouza will begin as CEO on August 10, taking over from the interim CEO who has been leading the company since Alexandr Wang, its founder and former CEO, joined Meta in June 2025.
Joe Osborne, a spokesperson for Scale AI, said the company’s new focus on building AI applications for enterprises and governments, rather than solely data labeling, has it projecting more than $1 billion in 2026 revenue.

# Scale AI Names Google Cloud Executive Francis deSouza as New CEO
Francis deSouza, who is currently the chief operating officer and president of security products at [Google Cloud](https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/8888000D:US) , will assume the role at Scale on Aug. 10.
He succeeds interim CEO Jason Droege, who took over after founder Alexandr Wang left to join Meta.
